moves.name: Trick Room
moves.description:
Psychic (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: -7
For 5 turns, the Speed of every Pokemon is recalculated for the purposes of determining turn order. During the effect, each Pokemon's Speed is considered to be (10000 - its normal Speed), and if this value is greater than 8191, 8192 is subtracted from it. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 4
The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

moves.name: Horn Leech
moves.description:
Grass (Physical)
Base Power: 75
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.

moves.name: Poltergeist
moves.description:
Ghost (Physical)
Base Power: 110
Accuracy: 90
Priority: 0
Fails if the target has no held item.

moves.name: Leech Seed
moves.description:
Grass (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 90
Priority: 0
The Pokemon at the user's position steals 1/8 of the target's maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn. If Big Root is held by the recipient, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will continue being leeched. If the target switches out or uses Mortal Spin or Rapid Spin successfully, the effect ends. Grass-type Pokemon are immune to this move on use, but not its effect.

moves.name: Forest's Curse
moves.description:
Grass (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Causes the Grass type to be added to the target, effectively making it have two or three types. Fails if the target is already a Grass type. If Trick-or-Treat adds a type to the target, it replaces the type added by this move and vice versa.

moves.name: Wood Hammer
moves.description:
Grass (Physical)
Base Power: 120
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

moves.name: Will-O-Wisp
moves.description:
Fire (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 85
Priority: 0
Burns the target.

moves.name: Shadow Claw
moves.description:
Ghost (Physical)
Base Power: 70
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

moves.name: Ally Switch
moves.description:
Psychic (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 2
The user swaps positions with its ally. Fails if the user is the only Pokemon on its side. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails or if the user's last move used is not Ally Switch.

items.name: Sitrus Berry
items.description: Restores 1/4 max HP when at 1/2 max HP or less. Single use.

items.name: Occa Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Fire-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Colbur Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Dark-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Coba Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Flying-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Leftovers
items.description: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.

items.name: Big Root
items.description: Holder gains 1.3x HP from draining/Aqua Ring/Ingrain/Leech Seed/Strength Sap.

items.name: Focus Sash
items.description: If holder's HP is full, will survive an attack that would KO it with 1 HP. Single use.

items.name: Mental Herb
items.description: Cures holder of Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, Torment. Single use.

items.name: King's Rock
items.description: Holder's attacks without a chance to make the target flinch gain a 10% chance to make the target flinch. Evolves Poliwhirl into Politoed and Slowpoke into Slowking when traded.

abilities.name: Harvest
abilities.description: If the last item this Pokemon used is a Berry, there is a 50% chance it gets restored at the end of each turn. If Sun is active, this chance is 100%.

abilities.name: Natural Cure
abilities.description: This Pokemon has its non-volatile status condition cured when it switches out.

abilities.name: Frisk
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon identifies the held items of all opposing Pokemon.
